papers.title: MPIE-Bench: Benchmarking Anatomically Plausible Multi-Person Interaction Editing
papers.abstract: Introduces a benchmark for evaluating multi-person interaction editing in images, addressing failures like fused limbs and invented extremities through mesh-based anatomical and geometric scoring.

papers.title: Beyond Borrowed Histories: Person-Aligned User Simulation for Interactive Role-Playing Evaluation
papers.abstract: Proposes PALATE, a scalable role-playing agent benchmark using personalized user simulators and tailored rubrics to evaluate user-RPA interactions across multi-turn conversations with character profiles.

papers.title: See2Think: Do Multimodal Models Really Use Intermediate Visual States?
papers.abstract: Evaluates whether multimodal models genuinely rely on intermediate visual states during reasoning through See2ThinkBench, a framework with 1,200 visually-dependent problems across 12 task categories.

papers.title: β-OPSD: Deriving with Policy Optimization, Training with Self-Distillation
papers.abstract: Proposes β-OPSD to improve reasoning language models by generalizing on-policy self-distillation as a policy-optimization family, trading off proximity to reference policies against teacher guidance.

papers.title: ShadowDancer: Teaching Video World Models Any Action by Learning Unified Dynamics Representations
papers.abstract: Introduces shadow pairs and cross-shadow prediction to enable frame-level control of interactive video world models, allowing demonstrated actions to transfer to new scenes without fine-tuning.

papers.title: Can Large Language Models Execute Parent Orders?
papers.abstract: Presents PACE, a hierarchical LLM framework for algorithmic trading order execution that performs hierarchical planning and control without requiring explicit market assumptions or task-specific training.

papers.title: Explorative Modeling: Unlocking a Third Pretraining Axis and End-to-End Generation
papers.abstract: Introduces Explorative Modeling, a paradigm that factors training loops to explore multiple candidate matches, improving generative model efficiency by 4.1x FLOP and enabling end-to-end generation.

papers.title: Σ-Mem: An Online Reliability Memory for LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract: Proposes a reliability memory system using spectral methods to track peer competence and relationships, enabling adaptive coordination in multi-agent systems through online Weyl-inequality-bounded updates.

papers.title: LEDGERMIND: Provenance-Constrained Multimodal Agentic Reasoning with a Structured Evidence Ledger
papers.abstract: Introduces a provenance-constrained framework treating multimodal agent trajectories as state machines with structured evidence ledgers, improving both answer accuracy and trajectory-level faithfulness.

papers.title: Multi-Head Attention Residuals
papers.abstract: Proposes MHAR to improve information propagation by reshaping routing queries into per-subspace heads, achieving validation loss improvements of -0.061 to -0.149 across model scales from 100M to 1B.

cc_updates.body: Added Claude Opus 5 (claude-opus-5), now the default Opus model — 1M context, fast mode at $10/$50 per Mtok. Added sandbox.network.strictAllowlist setting to deny non-allowlisted hosts for sandboxed commands without prompting. Added DirectoryAdded hook that fires after /add-dir or the SDK register_repo_root control request registers a new working directory mid-session. Added mcp_server_errors to the headless stream-json init event. Added nested subagent forwarding in stream-json. Fixed claude -p text output dropping the answer. Improved HTTP status error reporting. Fixed various permission and model selection issues. Removed Opus 4.7 from fast mode.

Changed /code-review to run as a background subagent. Added screen-reader announcements of deleted text. Fixed Windows paths with \u-prefixed segments being corrupted into CJK characters. Fixed left arrow key discarding conversation. Added HTTP status and error text to claude mcp list. Fixed multi-line paste collapsing. Fixed /context reporting stale token usage. Fixed /ultrareview failing on descriptive arguments. Fixed various permission, MCP, and rendering issues. Improved auto mode and error feedback.
